diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_lambda_function.webhook must wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured. The role ARN reference only waits for role creation, not attachment of the EC2 network-interface permissions required for Lambda VPC provisioning. Add depends_on on the attachment; this also preserves permissions until function deletion completes.

:resource.aws_lambda_function.dispatcher must wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.dispatcher_vpc_execution_role when VPC subnets are configured. Referencing the execution role does not wait for the attachment that supplies EC2 network-interface permissions needed for VPC provisioning. Add depends_on on the attachment to order creation and retain these permissions through function deletion.

:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.dispatcher can enable event delivery before :resource.aws_lambda_permission.allow_cloudwatch_to_call_lambda grants EventBridge permission to invoke the function. Add depends_on on the permission so the target is not activated before invocation is authorized.
